The full name Nicholas Anthony Coulouthros Embiricos is attached to fifteen ordinary shares in a London residential property-management company. The shorter Nicholas Anthony Embiricos form also belongs to a London-linked college graduate. Neither identification carries a birth date or occupation, leaving open whether they describe the same individual or different generations of a family that reused the name.

Basil's corporate identity confirms the distinctive Coulouthros Embiricos family name, but it does not establish a direct link to this Nicholas. The residential-company stake is the only personal holding attributable to the exact name.
